source.author: verg
source.text: Proxima quaeque metit gladio latumque per agmen ardens limitem agit ferro, te, Turne, superbum caede nova quaerens.
source.text_original: Proxima quaeque metit gladio latumque per agmen / ardens limitem agit ferro, te, Turne, superbum / caede nova quaerens.
source.text_english: She mows down each nearest man with her sword and, blazing through the broad ranks, cuts a wide path with her steel, seeking you, Turnus, in your pride with fresh slaughter.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ecce de caelo tuba canit, ecce cum nubibus debellaturus orbem imperator armatus egreditur, ecce bis acutus gladius ex regis ore procedens obuia quaeque metit: et tu mihi de cubiculo ad aciem, de umbra egrederis ad solem?
reuse.text_original: ecce de caelo tuba canit, ecce cum nubibus debellaturus orbem imperator armatus egreditur, ecce bis acutus gladius ex regis ore procedens obuia quaeque metit: et tu mihi de cubiculo ad aciem, de umbra egrederis ad solem?
reuse.text_english: Behold, a trumpet sounds from heaven; behold, the armed commander comes forth, about to wage war on the world with the clouds; behold, a double-edged sword proceeding from the mouth of the king reaps everything in its path. And do you, for my sake, step out from the bedchamber into battle, from shade into the sun?
